candidate_attachment_policy.use: Pass an explicitly supplied reference image/video into the current agent run as a visual comparison input when the attachment is accessible to the tool.
candidate_attachment_policy.promotion: Never promote a candidate to an authoritative master unless the user explicitly approves the replacement.
candidate_attachment_policy.access_failure: If the agent cannot access chat attachments, request an accessible URL or upload into the configured reference vault. Never claim the candidate was used.
candidate_attachment_policy.comparison: Check face shape, eyes, freckles, skin tone, hairline/hairstyle, facial structure, and body proportions where visible; video frame sampling only when supported.
candidate_attachment_policy.uncertain_result: Return NOT_VERIFIED if the image/video cannot be inspected or compared reliably.

identity_rules.cross_check: The two active references previously matched visually across face, hair, facial structure and body build.
identity_rules.generation_gate: Any material deviation from the active reference set must be rejected and regenerated only within the approved generation budget.
identity_rules.publishing: Publishing remains approval-controlled; never publish without explicit user approval.
